description: GOD RULE 2 violation: Verus specs not mathematically bound to production exec fn. All 9 Verus files define standalone spec fn/proof fn in verification/verus/ with 'PRODUCTION BINDING:' comments but ZERO requires/ensures annotations on actual production code in crates/vb_storage/. Production code grep for 'requires|ensures|verus!' in crates/vb_storage/src/ and crates/vb_core/src/ returns ZERO matches. GOD RULE 2: 'Verus proof fn and spec fn models MUST mathematically bind to the actual Rust implementations (exec fn) inside the production codebase.' Comments referencing source locations are documentation, not mathematical binding.
artifact: verification/verus/vb-vzcuf-PS-001.rs through PS-009.rs; crates/vb_storage/src/batch.rs; crates/vb_storage/src/error/mod.rs; crates/vb_storage/src/codec/mod.rs
expected: requires/ensures annotations on production exec fn in crates/vb_storage/src/ verified by Verus, or a documented structural blocker
found: Standalone spec models with 'PRODUCTION BINDING:' documentation comments. Production code has zero Verus annotations. PS-003 defines ErrorVariant enum locally (not JournalError). PS-008 defines Guard enum locally. JournalWriteBatch lacks staged_bytes and byte_limit fields.
remediation: Add requires/ensures to production exec fn AND verify with Verus, OR file blockers/vb-vzcuf-god-rule-2-blocker.md with concrete plan and compensating proptest evidence. Production binding comments are insufficient.

description: Trusted base entries self-approved by proof-writer. All 9 TBP entries have owner:'proof-writer', reviewer_disposition:'accepted', status:'accepted'. TBP-006 (future_implementation: JournalWriteBatch will gain staged_bytes) and TBP-007 (future_implementation: JournalError will gain AccumulatedBytesExceeded) accept as trusted that code which does not exist will be implemented correctly. Compensating evidence cites Verus specs that themselves violate GOD RULE 2.
expected: Independent reviewer disposition for all TBP entries. TBP-006/TBP-007 cannot be accepted until implementation exists.
found: All 9 entries self-approved by proof-writer at State 5. No independent review. TBP-006 compensating_evidence:'Verus specs model the fields and invariants' — circular dependency.
remediation: Reset all TBP entries to status:pending. TBP-006 and TBP-007 cannot be accepted until production code implements the fields/variants they describe.

description: Verus PS-003 defines local ErrorVariant enum in verification/verus/ and proves its variants are distinct. This is a tautology: distinct Rust enum variants are ALWAYS distinct by construction. Proving ErrorVariant::AccumulatedBytesExceeded != ErrorVariant::QueueFull in a locally-defined 3-variant enum proves nothing about the production JournalError enum with 28+ variants. GOD RULE 2 explicitly forbids this pattern: 'You cannot define an enum in verification/verus/, prove its properties by(compute), and call it a day.'
expected: Proof about actual production JournalError enum from crates/vb_storage/src/error/mod.rs
found: Locally-defined ErrorVariant enum with 3 variants. lemma_error_variant_distinct_from_queue_full proves A != Q where A and Q are locally-defined.
remediation: Either prove properties of the actual production JournalError enum, or delete the tautological lemmas and replace with a structural blocker document.

description: Verus PS-008 defines local Guard enum in verification/verus/ and proves guard_precedence_order() by asserting 0<1<2<3<4 on locally-defined guard indices. lemma_guard_precedence_well_ordered proves this tautology with an empty body (by construction). This proves nothing about the production append_event control flow in batch.rs:210-228. The production code does not use or reference this Guard type.
expected: Proof verifying actual guard ordering from production append_event method's control flow structure
found: Locally-defined Guard enum with indices 0-4. guard_precedence_order() returns true by definition. Lemma body is empty (proved by type system).
remediation: Either verify guard ordering from actual production append_event control flow, or delete the tautological proof and use behavioral tests (proptest) as compensating evidence.

description: Production code lacks the fields and variants being verified. JournalWriteBatch (batch.rs:38-45) has no staged_bytes:u64 or byte_limit:u64 fields. JournalError (error/mod.rs:20-247) has no AccumulatedBytesExceeded variant. Verification artifacts model behavior for code that does not exist. When implemented, actual behavior may diverge from models.
expected: JournalWriteBatch with staged_bytes:u64, byte_limit:u64 fields. JournalError with AccumulatedBytesExceeded variant.
found: JournalWriteBatch has: inner, journal, staged_event_keys, aborted, _not_send_or_sync — no byte accounting fields. JournalError has ~28 variants — no AccumulatedBytesExceeded.
remediation: Implement staged_bytes and byte_limit fields in JournalWriteBatch and AccumulatedBytesExceeded variant in JournalError, or acknowledge as structural blocker and reduce scope of verification claims.

description: Verus PS-004 lemmas prove trivial properties, not general invariants. lemma_rejection_state_reflexive proves state_unchanged_after_rejection(state, state) — identity tautology (proves state==state). lemma_acceptance_updates_state requires the desired conclusion as a precondition. lemma_aborted_batch_no_commit proves !true==false, a Rust boolean tautology. These do not establish that rejection preserves state for all possible inputs.
expected: General proof: forall before, after: BatchState, accumulated_byte_rejection(before, after) ==> state_unchanged(before, after)
found: Trivial lemmas: reflexivity, precondition-as-conclusion, boolean tautology.
remediation: Rewrite lemmas to prove general invariants (forall quantified) rather than trivial identities. Use parameterized arguments instead of hardcoded struct values.

description: Verus PS-001 lemmas prove single concrete cases, not general properties. lemma_exact_fit_accepted proves admit_bytes(500_000, 548_576, 1_048_576).is_ok(). lemma_over_limit_rejected proves admit_bytes(1_000_000, 100_000, 1_048_576).is_err(). lemma_overflow_rejected proves admit_bytes(u64::MAX, 1, u64::MAX).is_err(). These are unit tests encoded as Verus lemmas, not general mathematical proofs.
expected: General proofs: forall t, n, limit satisfying appropriate bounds, admission behavior is correct
found: Three lemmas each proving a single concrete tuple of values
remediation: Generalize lemmas with quantified preconditions or parameterized arguments covering the domain of interest.
